name: 表の追加・整列・保存操作帯
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
One Japanese Lighthouse table-action toolbar LH09-0031, a compact very wide strip about1188x50 logical pixels. Originals images1–2 control icon shape, stroke, proportions, spacing, alignment, split-button geometry and every visible control. Mock3 is Japanese wording only; its crude glyphs and omitted controls must NOT be copied.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas/toolbar. Fine neutral top/bottom rule, no gray/mint panel. At far left: small rounded split button with thin plus, label「作業を追加」and a separately divided narrow DOWN chevron segment. This is the primary action: official135deg gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with white text/plus/chevron. Maintain original slim26px button height, approximately6px corner radius, no huge CTA.
Large empty middle gap, then right-aligned original compact action sequence on one baseline:
- Original FILTER glyph with three diminishing horizontal strokes, label「絞り込み」
- Original SORT glyph, two parallel vertical arrows in opposite directions, label「並べ替え」
- Original GROUP glyph, tiny outlined rounded square containing a2x2 small-cell grid, label「分類」
- thin vertical separator
- Original OPTIONS glyph, two thin horizontal slider lines with offset small circle knobs, label「表示」
- original standalone thin magnifying-glass search button, no label
- original WHITE rounded split button「表示を保存」with thin neutral border and separate right DOWN-chevron compartment.
Do not omit search or either split divider/chevron. Do not substitute text characters, emoji, hamburger/menu dots, generic list icons or random icon colors. All utility icons #526173, original optical size about12–14px; source-like thin consistent strokes. Labels Meiryo Regular14/24, zero tracking, all regular weight, dark/slate. Compact breathable spacing matched to original, Japanese label widths fitted naturally. All controls fully visible with small outer inset. No heading, table rows, sidebar, app shell, watermark, annotations, perspective, or comparison grid. Crisp flat UI screenshot, tight framing with little outside whitespace.
reviewNotes: 日本語の追加・絞り込み・並べ替え・分類・表示・保存、元の検索、追加と保存の分割ボタン／下向き矢印を目視確認。元アイコン形状を優先し、追加のみ正式緑グラデーションに適応。大きい外側白余白は残差。厳密なフォント・ベクター同一性や実装動作、所有者承認は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
